salesRequestFields.value: Seasonal footwear and apparel launches are risky because style, size, color, replenishment timing, and channel availability are managed across spreadsheets and disconnected order/inventory views.
Show a concise NetSuite proof path for style/SKU readiness, size/color availability, replenishment timing, and customer promise.

Ariat sells footwear, apparel, workwear, outdoor gear, size/color variants, and ecommerce categories.
